calendarFaqs.q: Is May 2, 2028 definitely a no-school day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. SWCS labels May 2 as a tentative Election Day closure subject to the Board of Elections primary date.

calendarFaqs.q: Why is April 14 labeled only “No School”?
calendarFaqs.a: The official PDF says only No School. This page does not add a reason the district did not print.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the malformed April 2028 grid change any dates?
calendarFaqs.a: No. We do not treat the repeated 25 and 26 cells as additional school dates. The separate Important Student Dates table lists April 14 as the month's only no-school date.

calendarFaqs.q: Does SWCS publish a Spanish school calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. SWCS publishes an official Spanish version of the 2027–28 calendar; it is linked in the Downloads section above.
